_ruleNotes.selector-class-pattern, custom-property-: The site uses a kh-/vf- BEM dialect (block__element--modifier) for classes, custom properties and Sass variables. standard-scss expects plain kebab-case, which rejects every __ and -- in the codebase: 625 of the 694 findings. CLAUDE.md pins these names for markup and path stability, so the pattern rules are off rather than the names changed.
_ruleNotes.property-no-vendor-prefix, at-rule-no-ve: The prefixes here are load-bearing, not leftovers: -webkit-mask (Safari before 15.4), -webkit-text-size-adjust (iOS orientation), -webkit-appearance (vendored normalize) and @-moz-document, the Firefox-only opt-out from the expensive SVG filter documented in _kh-ambience.scss.
_ruleNotes.value-keyword-case: Font family names are proper nouns; lowercasing Roboto/Helvetica/Consolas would be wrong. The rule stays on for every other property.
_ruleNotes.media-feature-range-notation: Breakpoint queries are written with Sass variables, which this rule cannot convert. Enforcing range notation would rewrite only the two literal-valued queries and leave the rest in min-/max- form, adding inconsistency rather than removing it.
_ruleNotes.declaration-block-no-redundant-longhand-: Both findings are unwanted. grid-column: span 2 leaves grid-column-end at auto, so the grid-column-end: span 2 that follows is not redundant; and the margin block it flags has each side individually documented as part of a float invariant.
_ruleNotes.normalize.scss: Vendored third-party code, ignored rather than reformatted.
